title: Cefazolin Rate Schedule — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Outpatient Surgery
content:
| Payer class | Cefazolin (code J0690 under revenue code 0636) rate per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 6.40 USD |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 7.10 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage |

This schedule applies to cefazolin billed on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) when its value is figured on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing). Cefazolin is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Example (hypothetical): 3 units on a Commercial HMO Claim with charges of 60.00 are valued at 21.30; the same 3 units with charges of 15.00 are valued at 15.00.
